blurb: Guests board The Sapphire Princess, a modern luxury yacht designed for special events including weddings, corporate events, parties, and celebrations. The yacht features panoramic bay views, a full service bar, dance floor, DJ booth, and multiple seating areas. Events include elegant dining, live entertainment, and private cruises on Long Island and the Great South Bay.
